title: Big Tech’s $2 trillion AI shakeout just changed everything
excerpt: Wall Street just drove a harsh line through the artificial intelligence trade. Amazon (AMZN), Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL)added nearly $1.5 trillion...
content_html:
Wall Street just drove a harsh line through the artificial intelligence trade.

Amazon (AMZN), Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL)added nearly $1.5 trillion in combined market value during earnings week, according to CNBC. Microsoft gained more than $600 billion, while Amazon and Alphabet each added more than $400 billion.

Other tech giants took a hit.

Apple (AAPL) shed more than $350 billion in market cap as supply problems dimmed its outlook. Meta Platforms (META) erased over $85 billion in market value as investors questioned the return on its heavy investment in AI technology. Tesla (TSLA) dropped over $7 billion after posting negative free cash flow and forecasting heavier spending.

The six firms saw over $2 trillion come in or go out.

The companies were not afraid to spend money. Jefferies estimates Big Tech's AI spend is on track to reach about $800 billion in the next 12 months.

Amazon increased its 2026 capital-expenditure forecast to $220 billion and still soared.

The difference was obvious. Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet revealed that people are already paying to use the infrastructure they are developing.

There was no mistaking Wall Street's message.

AI ambition alone won't be enough. Investors want to see the bill and proof that someone is paying it.

"It's whether in the long term demand is going to be sufficiently profitable to warrant all of this investment," Jefferies investment banker Jason Greenberg told CNBC.

Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet passed the AI payback test

Amazon's results provide the strongest evidence that big spending can still lure investors.

Amazon Web Services revenue rose 37% from a year earlier, the best gain since 2021. Most of Amazon's AI-related business is booked in its cloud segment, so that acceleration is a direct hint customers are buying more computer power.

Amazon stock rose more than 15%, even as management boosted projected capital investment for 2026 from $200 billion to $220 billion.

Related: Amazon is selling a 2-in-1 laptop and tablet for $66

Microsoft, too, returned a similar result.

Shares rose almost 15% after investors applauded the robust growth in Azure and Microsoft's overall cloud operation. Microsoft may install pricey processors in its data centers and sell access to them via cloud subscriptions, enterprise applications, and AI services.

Alphabet's fast-growing Google Cloud rounded out the victorious trifecta.

All three have something Meta, Apple, and Tesla don't have at the same scale: established cloud platforms that can leverage processors, power, and data center capacity into recurring revenue.

content_html_zh:
华尔街刚刚对人工智能行业采取了严厉的态度。

据 CNBC 报道，亚马逊 (AMZN)、微软 (MSFT) 和 Alphabet (GOOGL) 在财报周期间的总市值增加了近 1.5 万亿美元。 微软的涨幅超过 6000 亿美元，而亚马逊和 Alphabet 的涨幅均超过 4000 亿美元。

其他科技巨头也受到了打击。

由于供应问题令其前景黯淡，苹果公司 (AAPL) 市值缩水超过 3500 亿美元。 由于投资者质疑 Meta Platforms (META) 对人工智能技术的大量投资的回报，其市值蒸发了超过 850 亿美元。 特斯拉 (TSLA) 在发布负自由现金流并预测支出增加后，股价下跌超过 70 亿美元。

这六家公司的流入或流出超过 2 万亿美元。

这些公司并不害怕花钱。 Jefferies 估计，未来 12 个月内，大型科技公司的人工智能支出有望达到约 8000 亿美元。

亚马逊将 2026 年资本支出预测提高至 2200 亿美元，并且仍在飙升。

差异是显而易见的。 亚马逊、微软和 Alphabet 透露，人们已经付费使用他们正在开发的基础设施。

华尔街传递的信息是准确无误的。

仅靠人工智能的野心是不够的。 投资者希望看到账单和有人付款的证据。

杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 投资银行家贾森·格林伯格 (Jason Greenberg) 向 CNBC 表示：“问题在于，从长远来看，需求是否能够带来足够的利润来保证所有这些投资。”

亚马逊、微软和 Alphabet 通过了人工智能投资回收测试

亚马逊的业绩提供了最有力的证据，证明巨额支出仍然可以吸引投资者。

亚马逊网络服务收入同比增长 37%，是 2021 年以来的最佳增幅。 亚马逊大部分人工智能相关业务都集中在其云领域，因此加速是客户正在购买更多计算能力的直接暗示。

尽管管理层将 2026 年的预计资本投资从 2000 亿美元提高到 2200 亿美元，但亚马逊股价仍上涨了 15% 以上。

相关：亚马逊正在以 66 美元的价格出售二合一笔记本电脑和平板电脑

微软也返回了类似的结果。

在投资者对 Azure 和微软整体云业务的强劲增长表示赞赏后，股价上涨了近 15%。 微软可能会在其数据中心安装昂贵的处理器，并通过云订阅、企业应用程序和人工智能服务出售对它们的访问权限。

Alphabet 快速增长的谷歌云完成了三连胜。

这三者都拥有 Meta、苹果和特斯拉同等规模所不具备的东西：成熟的云平台，可以利用处理器、电力和数据中心容量来产生经常性收入。
